fusions.name: Barbs in the Tines
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health. Looses 3 barbs at once, spread apart, each dealing 6 damage, with a 40% chance per hit to leave the target [Bleeding] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Rip It Free
fusions.desc: Tears the barbs back out of the target, dealing 22 damage and making it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Snag and Reel
fusions.desc: Catches the tines on a point up to 6 tiles away and puts you there instantly.

fusions.name: Barb Sets Deep
fusions.desc: Against an enemy below half health, your damage rises by 12%.
